status_reason: Forge V2 Institutional Pipeline (REJECTED): Trades=23, WinRate=39.1%, BaseNet=-3.149%, StressNet=-3.549%, WF=0/4, EarlyCuts=1, NearTPSaves=1, TPExpansions=0, MC95 DD=5.46%.

atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for GBPUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=2.651, trend_persistence=0.269, mean_reversion=0.731. Learned timeframe weights: M15 (w=+0.336), H4 (w=+0.264), H1 (w=+0.182). Ablation-retained features: ema_trend (w=+0.477), bos_breakout (w=+0.290), fvg_impulse (w=+0.101), pulse_social_sentiment (w=+0.098) (pruned/left out by ablation: liquidity_sweep, dealing_range_reversion, sentinel_news_sentiment).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for GBPUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=2.651, mean-reversion=0.731). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to M15 (w=+0.336), H4 (w=+0.264), H1 (w=+0.182). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [ema_trend (w=+0.477), bos_breakout (w=+0.290), fvg_impulse (w=+0.101), pulse_social_sentiment (w=+0.098)] and pruned [liquidity_sweep, dealing_range_reversion, sentinel_news_sentiment].

mtf_intelligence_and_sensitivity_report.design_rule_enforced: Contextual weighted agreement: trades are evaluated via learned timeframe weights and never rejected solely because all 7 timeframes do not point in the same direction.
